c1.note: The 8-K and 10-K show $478,834M total net sales; MacRumors reports $478.8B, up 15%.

c2.note: Earnings call: $478.8B revenue, up 15% year over year; 478,834 / 416,161 = 1.15.

c3.note: Prior-year comparison: $416.2B in fiscal 2025; the 416,161 row appears in the earnings release.

c4.note: 416,161 vs 391,035 is +6.4%, which rounds to 6%; this is background history.

c5.note: Fiscal 2024 net sales were $391,035M, matching Apple's reported figure; the 10-K covers 2024.

c6.note: CFO quote: 'all-time record revenue of $479 billion'.

c9.note: Year-ago quarter revenue was $102.5B, consistent with 102,466.

c10.note: The release states quarterly revenue of $114.5B, up 12 percent year over year.

c11.note: Press release is dated November 2, 2026; the quarter ended September 26, 2026.

c12.note: Fiscal Q4 and the year ended September 26, 2026.

c13.note: The fiscal year ends in late September, not December 31.

c14.note: Fiscal 2025 ended Sept 27, 2025 (Saturday), so fiscal 2026 began Sept 28, 2025, not Sept 29.

c15.note: The 8-K comparative column is dated September 27, 2025.

c16.note: Apple's statements use the line item 'Total net sales' (478,834 for FY26), which is its term for revenue.

c17.note: Apple's earnings-release statements are labeled unaudited, though the saved excerpt does not show the label. The audited 10-K covers the same year.

c18.note: The saved passages are truncated, but 355.533 plus 123.301 equals the 478.834 total net sales, so the split is consistent.

c19.note: Services of 123.301 plus products of 355.533 equals the 478.834 total, so the figure is consistent.

c21.note: The cash flow statement shows net income of 132,175 for the twelve months ended Sept 26, 2026.

c22.note: FY2025 net income of 112,010 is shown as the prior-year comparison; it is historical context.

c23.note: MacRumors states $478.8B in sales and $132.2B in net income for the fiscal year, against $416.2B and $112.0B in FY2025.

c24.note: Apple's press release states diluted EPS of $2.10 for Q4.

c26.note: MacRumors reports $30.7B for Q4 against $27.5B a year earlier, matching 30,711 and 27,466. The live-blog line saying $37B appears to be a transcription error.

c27.note: The release states gross margin of 47.9 percent including about 1 point from tariff refunds.

c28.note: The CFO quote in the release says September-quarter records for net income and EPS, and double-digit EPS growth for the year.

c29.note: The CFO quote states $28B in operating cash flow and $28B returned to shareholders.

c30.note: The CFO quote in the release states the installed base reached an all-time high across all major categories and segments.
